en: A sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town in a hilly, vineyard-like landscape. Numerous villas and houses with steep roofs and ornate facades fill the foreground and middle ground, surrounded by many trees. On the hill in the background stands a prominent building complex labeled as a mountain guesthouse, likely with a tower or lookout. German text identifying the location and the guesthouse is printed at the top of the image.
